name: Palm-nut sweet soup
summary: Chè thốt nốt is the palm-nut bowl in Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter. The nuts from the plains around Châu Đốc yield a clear jelly, mixed with coconut cream and shaved ice. Eat it as an afternoon snack or a light dessert. VnExpress also lists the fruit itself, quả thốt nốt, among the gifts to carry home.
origin: Palms on the plains around Châu Đốc, on Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter.
texture: Vietnam Tourism says the nut gives a clear jelly, mixed with coconut cream and shaved ice.
howToEat: Order the bowl cold, in the afternoon or after a meal.
The fruit, quả thốt nốt, is a separate gift on the VnExpress handbook of 26 Apr 2024, beside đường thốt nốt. A price for the bowl or the fruit was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: In town, after the market or the hill. A shop was not named. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Che thot not in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Chè thốt nốt is palm-nut jelly with coconut cream and shaved ice, the afternoon sweet in Vietnam Tourism’s Châu Đốc chapter. A price was not printed.
